name: 69 kV wood pole, vertical with grounded neutral
description: 16 km distribution-class line: alternating davit arms, one conductor per phase, underbuilt neutral treated as a continuously grounded (eliminated) wire. Short line: the aerial travel time (about 54 us) is well below a 60 Hz quarter cycle, so adaptive steps exceed the delay during smooth operation.
source: GridWorkbench examples/emt/geometry/69kv-wood-pole.line.json; neutral phase changed from n to g
